reviews.title: Location Great Reception Staff Excellent, Basic. Slamming Doors Stuffy Rooms, Dirty Bathrooms
reviews.positive: Although the reception staff are only behind a tablet screen, they are excellent and friendly. I arrived on Monday 12 October and was greeted by a really nice girl who helped and was very accommodating. The Wi-Fi was good. The room had everything required for a basic stay. The location is excellent. The price was okay but still a bit higher than what I think is value for money considering the issues and lack of sleep and comfort overall that was affected by things that shouldn't happen.
reviews.negative: If you're happy with constant slamming of doors that cut through every single bone in your body, a stuffy room, and dirty bathrooms that don't get cleaned often then this is the place for you. The staff and other guests just don't give a crap about anyone else and constantly slam doors at any time. I was woken up multiple times every single night around 1am, 2am, 3am no one gives a sh1t. The staff used a room next to mine that was slammed every 2 minutes, and I was ready to ram their heads through the door and watch them bleed out. The room was stuffy and there's no fan to help and staff couldn't be bothered to get one. The shared bathroom was cleaned maybe once in 4 days and is pretty bad.

reviews.positive: We had a really great stay and would definitely recommend this hotel! The room was very clean, well organised and comfortable, and everything was exactly as we expected. The Wi-Fi worked perfectly throughout our stay, and the access system with the entry code was very simple, convenient and made everything feel easy and secure. A special thank you to Alona and Julie, who were absolutely amazing and so friendly! Even though the reception process was virtual when we arrived, they assisted us through the computer with the check-in and made the whole experience incredibly smooth. Everything was explained clearly, communication was excellent, and the process was quick and straightforward with no unnecessary complications or bureaucracy. We really appreciated how helpful, patient and welcoming they were. The location is also very convenient. It’s easy to get around using public transport, and being close to Allianz stadium and Bondi Beach is definitely a big plus, especially if you want to explore one of Sydney’s most popular areas. Overall, we really enjoyed the practicality of the hotel, the cleanliness, the location and especially the excellent customer service. Everything worked perfectly from check-in to check-out. Thank you again to Alona and Julie for making our stay even better. We would happily stay here again!
